narr: Tropical moisture ahead of Helene combined with a stalled boundary and instability to bring heavy rainfall across central Virginia. This led to instances of flooding and flash flooding.
ev: There were reports of partial road washouts due to several inches of swift water flowing across VA-632 Faber Road near US-29 Monacan Trail Road.
There were reports of mudslides with several inches of water flowing over US-29 Thomas Nelson Highway around the 20000 block.

The stream gauge on Mechums River at White Hall rose six feet in one hour, rising out its banks. The water level crested around 18.7 feet at 7:00 AM EST before finally falling below flood stage at 11:30 AM EST. At 18 feet, water reaches structures along Free Union Road.

Whiteside Branch rose rapidly out of its banks with several inches of swift moving water and tree and mud debris being swept across VA-693 Stillhouse Creek Road and VA-635 Craig Store Road at VA-692 Plank Road in Batesville.
Aistrop Lane was washed out and impassable due to high flowing water and debris near US-29 Thomas Nelson Highway.
Six to twelve inches of swift moving water blocked the intersection of VA-633 Amicus Road and VA-604 Celt Road, with rocks and debris blocking VA-604 Celt Road.
Six to twelve inches of swift moving water blocked VA-810 Dyke Road in a couple of locations in the 8800 Block, including at Roach River which rose rapidly out of its banks.
